changes: First version, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: SY MONO, a digital mono voice with a saw, a pulse, a sub one or two octaves down and noise.
A pitch LFO from 0.1 to 30 Hz for vibrato, trills and wobbles; tap encoder A for the range (16', 8', 4', 2').
Plays through the track's own analog filter, AMP and OVR, on any track of pads 1 to 8.
